title: Geekvape Wenax Q Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Wenax Q Pod Kit is an elegantly designed, highly portable, and easy-to-use pod system, perfect for vapers of all experience levels seeking a satisfying and discreet vaping experience. Equipped with an internal 1000mAh battery , the Wenax Q provides consistent power for extended vaping sessions, and with its convenient Type-C USB port , recharging is quick and effortless. Featuring a sleek, compact design with a smooth, glossy rounded body for a comfortable grip, the Wenax Q effortlessly fits in the palm of your hand, pocket or bag, making it the ideal companion for on-the-go vaping. The device boasts an intuitive firing mechanism, offering both auto-draw and button-activated firing options, catering to different vaping styles. Its childproof design prevents children from being able to activate the device with five presses of the fire button. The Geek Vape Wenax Q Pod Kit delivers an impressive power output range of 5-25W , optimised automatically for your pod’s resistance while also allowing you to customise your vaping experience to your preference. The device is compatible with Geek Vape Q fixed-coil 2ml refillable Pods renowned for their excellent flavour production and ease of use: when the coil in one pod loses its flavour, simply replace with a new one. The device allows you to fine-tune your vape to suit your preferred style, whether it's a tight, restricted draw or a more open, airy one, by rotating the pod. With its intelligent LED indicator, monitoring your battery level is simple and convenient. In summary, the Geek Vape Wenax Q Pod Kit combines portability, ease-of-use, and performance in a stylish, compact device. Whether you're new to vaping or an experienced vaper looking for a reliable and discreet device, the Wenax Q Pod Kit is an excellent choice. We recommend using the Geek Vape Wenax Q pod kit with 50/50 , high-PG and nicotine salts e-liquids. Pod Details: 0.4ohm Geekvape Q Replacement Pod is not compatible with this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
